description: Get historical market data (prices, market caps, volumes) for one coin over a number of days.

days.description: Number of days of historical data to return, as a string, e.g. '30'.

id.description: The CoinGecko coin ID to fetch the market chart for, e.g. 'bitcoin'.

vs_currency.description: The currency code to express prices, market caps, and volumes in, e.g. 'usd'.

name: get_market_chart
